Xi is expected to hold a bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi later today on the sidelines of the summit. The Modi-Xi meeting is being closely watched as India and China seek to consolidate a cautious improvement in bilateral ties following years of tensions along the Line of Actual Control. The two leaders are expected to discuss the border issue, economic and trade ties and broader bilateral relations. Xi’s visit comes after previous meetings with Modi in Kazan and Tianjin and is the latest high-level engagement between the two countries. India is hosting the BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12-13, bringing together leaders of the expanded 11-member grouping.

articles.title: Jaipur man serves father morning tea, flees after ‘killing wife and 3 daughters’
After killing wife, 3 daughters, man makes tea for father, takes bath
articles.summary: On Friday morning, tragedy struck in Jaipur as a man allegedly took the lives of his wife and three daughters. Following the crime, he prepared tea for his elderly father, indicating a chilling calmness. Authorities are investigating possible motivations including financial and marital strife, with the victims showing signs of blunt-force trauma. The police are currently seeking the suspect, Rahul Jha, who has vanished.
